props.text: Two flagship phones at the same price. The iPhone is the safer all-rounder; the Pixel wins on photos and AI features.

then.v: Its 50 MP sensor and editing tools take the better low-light shots.
It works best with the Apple devices you already own.

else.v: A little more screen-on time and slower battery wear.
